digest.component_or_area: AST provenance guards in subcall class selection tests
propositions: Session-scoped provenance fixture rebuilds parent maps and rediscovers callers via repeated whole-tree AST walks for every lookup, causing 49.96-53.58s setup overhead across Ubuntu CI cells.
Parent and caller relationships are recomputed millions of times (9.54M ast.walk iterations, 130.9M calls) despite parsing being cached, while producing identical ordered tuples.
Immutable process-local per-tree parent/enclosing-function and call-site indices must be built once from cached parsed trees to eliminate repeated rediscovery.
All 24 exact provenance tuples and four existing guard verdicts must remain unchanged after optimization.
Work-budget oracle must fail when whole-tree caller/parent rediscovery is reintroduced and pass only when indices are queried instead.
Paired cold-process timing must demonstrate measurable setup and runtime savings (target: 4x improvement from 9.54M to <600k AST iterations).
